newsitem.title: USA: Dresser, Chiyoda to build Exxon plant.
newsitem.headline: Dresser, Chiyoda to build Exxon plant.

text.p: The M.W. Kellogg Co, the engineering and construction arm of Dresser Industries Inc, and Chiyoda Corp have been selected by Exxon Chemcial Co to develop the engineering and plans for procurement and construction of an 800,000-ton-a-year grassroots ethylene plant in Singapore.

The steam cracker, part of Exxon's $2 billion petrochemical complex being constructed on Pulau Ayer Chawan that is scheduled to come onstream in 2000, will provide feedstock for several major downstream chemical plants, said the company.

The ethylene plant, as well as the offsites and utilities required for the entire complex, will be developed by Kellogg and Chiyoda as an extension of the Kellogg-Chiyoda ethylene technology alliance formed in 1996. Development of engineering, procurement and construction is underway.
